book.name: MATAIYO
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mataiyo wana Leleli

content: Gamagalau Bolo Yehoba I Muloluagil
Yeisu boda i kitel inoke i na i ha oyaa ge i misiyo. Yaka wana tohago hi nogogo elana,
inoke awana i pwela i panpankiti elal i ba:

content.text: Bolo hi atena yayaluwaliya i gulagula, Yehoba i muloluagil,
kaiwena Yehoba wana abalogugui iyaka i minek elal.
Bolo hi kahin Yehoba i muloluagil,
Bolo hi hanalau Yehoba i muloluagil,
kaiwena wana bateli panuwana nihi pwawa.
Bolo hi galebu ge hi walem pagan sasapona kaiwena, Yehoba i muloluagil,
Bolo avaliyau hi atilomwan-agil Yehoba i muloluagil,
Bolo nige ateliya i bibiki Yehoba i muloluagil,
Bolo huga ana topabakuhu Yehoba i muloluagil,
Bolo hi palomwanagil kaiwena Yehoba awana hi ab, Yehoba i muloluagil,
kaiwena Yehoba wana abalogugui iyaka i minek elal.

content: Ebo gamagalau hi kitemiu ku toulilau inoke hi ba sigasiga-agimiu, hi palomwanagimiu ge wasamiu hi wasa panapanak-an, ebo hi ginol ola o, Yehoba i muloluagimiu.
Nuku yaliyaya hot, kaiwena molamiu bwabwatana iyoho labulabumwa. He palopitau houhouwel hi palomwanagil i ola ya to.
Komiu Ku Ola Hoga ge Mwananal

Komiu wami tuwalali panayawi gamwanaa i ola hoga wana tuwalali. Yaa ebo hoga ana gasisi ge amnana ni so, nige bosowaina ta pahogahoga al. Nige al wana tuwalali i gagan, inoke ta aliyoho ge gamagalau nihi poti.
Komiu ku ola mwananal panayawi gamwanaa. Ebo panuwa etega nihi ginol oya pwatanaa, nasi gamagalau gegewel nihi kite.
Nige sauga etega gamagal odam ni toton yaka ulun ni aahe ni popom lowan. Nasi ni teliya teibol pwatanaa, inoke mwananal ni pek halan o ana tomina gegewel elal.
Komiu wami mwananal ni yana gamagalau elal ni ola al to, inoke wami ginol waiwaisana nihi kite ge Tamamiu labulabumwa alana nihi tobalan.
Yeisu I Nem Mosese wana Logugui Ni Patunahot
Bahi nuku nuwatu tage ya nem Mosese wana Logugui ge palopitau wali panpankiti na leke yoho. Nige ya nenem tage na lekel yohil, ya nem na patunahotil.
Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, ana siga labulabum ge panayawi nihi mowasi, nige Logugui ana baaba kekeisi etega ni yayaomal ana siga gegewena ni tabwa tunahot.

Henala ebo logugui kekeisi etega nige ni hehenapu-an ge gamagalau enuna al ni pankitel nihi ginol ola, he alana ni kekeisi Yehoba wana abalogugui elana. Yaa henala logugui ni henapuan ge gamagalau ni pankitel, he alana ni bwaya Yehoba wana abalogugui elana.

Palisi ge Logugui ana topankite hi ba tage heliya wali pagan i sapu, yaa na baewa eliyamiu, ebo nige wami pagan heliya wali pagan ni wawaisi lake, he nige bosowaimiu nuku ulutuk Yehoba wana abalogugui elana.
Yeisu I Panpankiti Huga Bana
Iyaka ku hago Mosese wana logugui gamagalau houhouwel elal i ola hiwe, “Bahi taulol. Henala ebo ni taulol nasi lahi ni pwawa.”

Yaa nau ya ba eliyamiu, henala ebo ni huga talina elana nasi lahi ni pwawa, henala ebo talina ana ba ni apapanak-an nasi nihi pakot, ge henala ebo ni ba, “Kokona owa!” i bosowaina ni na ginaha ni pwawa Gehena.
Inoke ebo nu nem limi bwabwalena elana tage wam mulolu u pepek Yehoba elana ge abwe nu nuwatu talim i hugaagiwa bugul etega kaiwena,
he wam mulolu nu teli limi bwabwalena elana nu na ga alom ge talim maninimiu nuku abubun. Yaka abwe nu sikalim ge wam mulolu nu pek Yehoba elana.

Ebo gamagal etega ni wolewa ge ni ahewa nuku na nu kot, he etimwawa alom woliwoli o nuku pasapu ga kamwasaa mulaa abwe nuku vin abakot elana. Ebo nigeya, nasi ni telewa toyatala elana, inoke toyatala ni telewa pulisiman nimaliyaa ge nihi telewa dela.
Ya ba tunahot elam, nige bosowaina nu tagil ana siga am vaga gegewena nu leke haba.
Yeisu I Panpankiti Loneganega kaiwena
Iyaka ku hago Mosese wana logugui i ola hiwe, “Bahi alom lagona nu loloneganega-an.”
Yaa nau ya ba eliyamiu, henala ebo yova etega ni gagayawa-an ge nuwana alona nihi kenu, iya iyaka i loneganega-an nuwatu elana.
Ebo matam toto labi awomwa ni pagegewa, nu bwana yoho. I waisi te ebo nige tuwam gabomwina etega ni gagan, bahi tuwam bwalibwaligena nihi aaliyoho Gehena elana.
I ola al, ebo nimwam toto awom ni pagegewa, nu gotomwa yoho. I waisi te ebo nige tuwam gabomwina etega ni gagan, bahi tuwam bwalibwaligena nihi aaliyoho Gehena elana.
Yeisu I Panpankiti Alolon ana Towa kaiwena
Mosese wana logugui i ba i ola hiwe, “Henala ebo nuwana lagona ni towani, houwan ga wana towa wasana ni leli lowan inoke ni pek yova elana.”

Yaa nau ya ba eliyamiu, ebo tau etega bwagana lagona nige i gaganawal ni towani, ge abwe yova o ni alolon al, he tau wana gegi kaiwena inoke yova o i tabwa toganawal. I ola al, tau toto yova eguluwan o ni alolonan, he iya i ganawal.
Yeisu I Panpankiti Papasila kaiwena
Iyaka ku hago al Mosese wana logugui gamagalau houhouwel elal i ola hiwe, “Bahi wam papasila nu leleke, yaa nu ginol ni ola wam bateli Yehoba elana.”
Yaa nau ya ba eliyamiu, bahi sauga etega nu papasila. Bahi nu ba, “O sila labulabum,” kaiwena Yehoba wana abamina to.
Bahi nu ba “O sila panayawi,” kaiwena aena ana abateli te. Bahi nu ba, “O sila Yelusalema,” kaiwena Kin bwabwatana wana panuwa to.
Bahi nu papasila kokowam elana, kaiwena nige bosowaina nu ba ge kokowam pupunona etega ni yanayana o ebo nu ba ge etega ni biki.
Iyai ya te nu ba, “E” o ebo “Nigeya”. Hauna gun al nu lumen i neem Seitani elana.
Bahi Tagatagalahi

Iyaka ku hago Mosese wana logugui i ola hiwe, “Ebo gamagal etega, alona matana maisena ni apanak, lahena iya al matana maisena nihi apanak. Ebo alona ninina maisena ni tagagebal, lahena iya al ninina maisena nihi tagagebal.”
Yaa nau ya ba eliyamiu, ebo gamagal etega ni ginol panak elam, bahi nu lalahe. Ebo gamagal etega gegenam toto awomwa ni taganepal, he nu tagena pil gegenam toto gegebamwa nu pek ni taganepal al.
I ola al, ebo gamagal etega ni telewa kot elana ge tage am holahola ni ahe, inoke am kaliko babalona toto tultul kaiwena nu talamwan al elana.
Ebo tolohaveyan etega am logugui ni ginol tage ana kaval nu kalivai hawawal kekeisi ni yapu, he nu kalivai hawawal yayapona elana.
Ebo gamagal etega ni awanun elam, nu pek elana; ebo gamagal etega wam bugul ni patalam, bahi nu kakaise.
Ami Topihigelgel Nuku Nunuwana-agil
Iyaka ku hago tage Mosese wana logugui i ba, “Wam heliyamwau nu nunuwana-agil, am topihigelgel nu hugaagil.”
Yaa nau ya ba eliyamiu, ami topihigelgel nuku nunuwana-agil ge bolo hi palomwanagimiu nuku awanun kaiweliya,

inoke nuku ola Tamamiu labulabumwa natunau. Kaiwena i ba sabwelu ni ha ge ni yana gamagalau nanakil ge gamagalau waiwaisal elal, ge kehe i patuna bolo wali pagan i sapu ge bolo wali pagan nige i sasapu elal.
Ebo bolo hi nunuwana-agimiu ya te nuku nunuwana-agil, ga i ola ge Yehoba ni pwamolamiu? Takis ana toahi hi giginol i oola al to, bwagana heliya nige gamagalau waiwaisal i oola.
Ebo talimiyau ya te nuku ba mulolu elal, nige i gegetoga toto gamagalau gegewel hi giginol. Bolo nige toabulilek i oola, hi giginol i oola al to.
Inoke komiu wami pagan bwalibwaligena ni waisi ni ola Tamamiu labulabumwa wana pagan bwalibwaligena i waisi.
